name: Tempo Run Intro
focus: First Zone 3 tempo stimulus — aerobic sharpening

steps.description: Z1 easy shuffle, HR <145 bpm — arrive at main set warm, not fatigued
Z2 aerobic transition, HR 146-162 bpm — let HR climb naturally
Z3 tempo, HR 163-172 bpm — controlled effort, short phrases possible but not comfortable conversation
Z2 come-down, HR 146-162 bpm — do not stop, keep moving
Z1 easy walk/jog, HR back below 145 bpm

name: Sweet Spot 2x6
focus: Peak cycling stimulus — sub-threshold sweet spot intervals

steps.description: Build from Z1 to Z2, cadence 85-90 rpm, HR climbing toward 150-155 bpm by end
Sweet spot upper Z3/low Z4 boundary, cadence 88-92 rpm, HR expect 163-172 bpm in final 2 min
Easy spin recovery, let HR drop before next rep
Gradual wind-down, HR below 140 before stopping

name: Lower Body & Core — Peak Week
focus: Progressive lower body and core — shoulder completely unloaded
notes: 3 rounds: 12x goblet squat 16kg, 10x Romanian deadlift 22kg, 10x TRX split squat per leg (TRX for balance only — zero load through shoulder), 20x banded glute bridge, 8x dead bug per side, 40s plank (substitute hollow body hold if any shoulder discomfort). 60s rest between rounds.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and lateral 10 each leg, hip circles 10 each direction, bodyweight squats x15, glute bridges x15
3 rounds: goblet squat 16kg x12, RDL 22kg x10, TRX split squat x10/leg, banded glute bridge x20, dead bug x8/side, plank 40s. 60s rest between rounds.
90/90 hip stretch 45s/side, supine hamstring stretch 45s/side, pigeon pose or figure-four glute stretch 45s/side
